prompt: How to get an Emirates ID?
actualResponse:
Step-by-Step Guide: How to Get an Emirates ID  The Emirates ID is a mandatory identification card for all UAE citizens and residents. It is essential for accessing government services, opening bank accounts, signing leases, and many other daily activities in the UAE. Below is a clear, step-by-step guide to obtaining your Emirates ID:  1. Ensure You Have a Valid UAE Residence Visa   You must have a valid UAE residence visa before you can apply for an Emirates ID. This is a strict requirement for expatriate residents3.  2. Prepare the Required Documents  The documents needed may vary depending on your nationality and age, but generally include:   Valid passport  UAE residence visa (for expatriates)  Passport-size photograph  Birth certificate (for children)  Additional documents as required for specific cases (e.g., GCC nationals, newborns)4.  3. Submit Your Application  You have two main options:   Online:  Apply through the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP) website or mobile app.  Typing Centre:  Visit an accredited typing centre, where staff will help you fill out the application form and collect your documents134.  4. Pay the Application Fee   Fees vary depending on the validity period of the Emirates ID and your residency status.  Payment can be made at the typing centre or online during the application process3.  5. Biometric Data Collection   After submitting your application, you will be notified to visit an ICP service centre to provide your biometric data (fingerprints and photograph).  This step is mandatory for most applicants and must be completed in person13.  6. Application Processing   Once your application and biometrics are complete, the ICP will process your Emirates ID request.  You will receive SMS notifications about the status of your application and when your card is ready for collection34.  7. Collect Your Emirates ID   You can collect your Emirates ID from the designated Emirates Post office or, in some cases, have it delivered to your registered address.  Track your application status online or via SMS updates13.  8. Urgent Service (Optional)   The ICP offers an urgent service called “Fawri” for UAE and GCC nationals, issuing the Emirates ID within 24 hours for an additional fee. Expatriate residents can use this service only for card replacements, not for new issuances1.  Important Notes   Carry your Emirates ID at all times; it is a legal requirement in the UAE.  If your Emirates ID is lost, stolen, or damaged, report it and apply for a replacement immediately1.  Update your Emirates ID details with the ICP if your personal information changes.  References  1: UAE Government – Emirates ID Application Process 
2: ICP – Interactive Services Overview 
3: First Abu Dhabi Bank – Expat Guide: Emirates ID 
4: Shuraa – Emirates ID Requirements   If you need more details about specific document requirements or have a unique situation (such as applying for a child or a newborn), please let me know!    Sources  Ask  Explain
